title: Operation ShadowCloud: initial infection and the GitDoor backdoor
description: Operation ShadowCloud is a sophisticated cyber intrusion campaign targeting government entities in Asia and Africa. It uses novel backdoors named GitDoor and GraphDoor deployed via the legitimate MeshAgent utility. These backdoors hide command-and-control communications by leveraging cloud platforms such as Microsoft SharePoint, GitHub, and Ably messaging services to evade network detection. The modular toolset supports on-demand plugin downloads and in-memory shellcode injection, enabling keylogging, screen capture, credential theft, and proxy deployment. The campaign employs DLL sideloading with legitimate executables to deliver encrypted payloads. Multiple GitHub repositories created since late 2024 are used for data exfiltration and command distribution. The operation uses advanced obfuscation techniques including control flow flattening and multi-stage payloads.
